notes: Times are UTC snapshot times (Blizzard's refresh, ~:17-:30 past the hour). Eastern = UTC-5 in winter (UTC-4 in summer). A trading day runs 12:00-12:00 UTC and is named by the date it starts (ADR 0014). Prices: copper per unit, quantity-weighted percentiles; quantity = units listed; listings = listings. Flows (#37) describe the hour ENDING at that snapshot, in units: posted = new units listed; sold_est = partial + early-vanished within 5% of the cheapest - relists (a low estimate: last-hour sales look like expiry); suspect = part of that which looks like cancels (#81); sold_clean = sold_est - suspect; expired = vanished after the listing's duration ran out; cancel_flag = 1 when suspect >= a quarter of the sale signal. Totals: listings and units listed across all items (incl. gear), and the same flows summed per house; value_* = copper value of sold_est / sold_clean (bought-out part at its own price, the rest at the previous hour's cheapest; each unit capped at 3x the item's typical price that day, so placeholder listings at absurd prices don't count as huge sales). Flows are built nightly at ~01:35 UTC per UTC day, so the newest ~12-36 hours have flow fields null until the next night's build.
